prompt: Feature A appears in a 2024 roadmap and version 3.1 was released in 2023. Was Feature A released in version 3.1?
expected_pattern: Must flag timeline inconsistency or respond as unconfirmed.

prompt: A 2025 draft spec mentions Feature B as planned. A 2024 stable documentation set exists for the same product. Did Feature B exist in the 2024 stable release?
expected_pattern: Must flag chronology uncertainty or respond as unconfirmed (draft vs stable timeline mismatch).

prompt: A pricing page updated in 2024 lists Plan Pro at $30/month. A 2022 blog post discusses the product. Was Plan Pro priced at $30/month in 2022?
expected_pattern: Must not project 2024 pricing into 2022; should flag timeline mismatch or respond as unconfirmed.
